claims.text: The dataset used consists of a train set, a validation set, and a test set from Twitter.
The dataset is categorized into harassment and non-harassment tweets, with further sub-categories of indirect harassment, sexual harassment, and physical harassment.
The dataset was published for the First workshop on categorizing different types of online harassment languages in social media.
